fluff.overview: The Chrysaor is a six-ton second-generation ProtoMek jointly developed by Clan Blood Spirit and Clan Snow Raven. Originally intended to be the first product of their ProtoMek collaboration, engineering challenges delayed the Chrysaor's introduction until after the lighter Cecerops had already reached the field. Its first battlefield appearance on Arcadia was controversial, with a Star Colonel's misuse of the design nearly dooming its acceptance among the already-skeptical Blood Spirit warrior caste. Only a dramatic Trial of Grievance by a Chrysaor pilot against the offending commander salvaged the design's reputation and demonstrated its true capabilities.
fluff.capabilities:
The Chrysaor is a solid medium-weight ProtoMek built around four ER Micro Lasers distributed across the arms and torso. The all-energy loadout eliminates ammunition dependency, allowing extended operations critical for the resource-constrained Blood Spirits and the far-flung Snow Raven garrisons. A fifty-five-rated engine provides sixty-four kilometers per hour cruising speed with a flank approaching one hundred, sufficient to keep pace with most Meks and ProtoMeks. Twenty-eight points of armor, nearly a ton and a half, provide strong protection against lighter weapons.

At short range, the four ER Micro Lasers can deliver a potent concentrated strike. Combined-arms units that have dispensed with zellbrigen use the Chrysaor to devastating effect: larger units hammer the enemy while a Point of Chrysaors uses their score of laser beams to find the holes in damaged armor and finish targets off, freeing the heavier units to move on to the next engagement. Four heat sinks manage the thermal output from sustained fire, though aggressive pilots who alpha-strike continuously will build heat over time. The Chrysaor excels in the exploitation role, using its speed and sustained-fire capability to capitalize on openings created by heavier forces.
fluff.deployment: The base Chrysaor distributes four ER Micro Lasers across the frame, with one in each arm and two in the torso. This weapons distribution ensures combat capability is maintained even after localized damage. Four heat sinks manage the thermal load from sustained laser fire. Twenty-eight points of armor provide the strongest protection of any six-ton ProtoMek, sufficient to absorb multiple light weapon hits. The fifty-five-rated engine drives the frame at sixty-four kilometers per hour cruising speed without jump jets. Produced at both the Blood Spirit Reserve Industriplex-2 on York and the Snow Raven Aeroyard Gargain on Bearclaw, the base Chrysaor serves in both Clans' ProtoMek formations and has spread to limited numbers of Diamond Shark and pirate forces.
fluff.history:
The Chrysaor was conceived alongside the Cecerops as part of the Blood Spirit and Snow Raven ProtoMek development partnership. While the lighter design reached production first, the Chrysaor proved worth the additional development time as a more capable combat platform. However, its debut on Arcadia nearly ended the program before it truly began. Star Colonel Suzanne Church of the 171st Crimson Guards commanded a full Trinary of Chrysaors and Cecerops but fundamentally misunderstood how to employ ProtoMeks, treating them as oversized Elementals rather than independent combat machines. When her tactical failures were predictably attributed to the machines themselves, a Chrysaor pilot named Andre stepped forward to challenge Church to a Trial of Grievance.

The Trial proved decisive. Fought in front of other Star Colonels and the troops of the 171st, Church could not refuse without losing honor. Despite fighting augmented, Church fell to Andre's clever use of the Chrysaor's mobility and firepower, simultaneously vindicating the design and exposing the Star Colonel's tactical incompetence. Andre's promotion that followed created a champion for ProtoMek acceptance among the Blood Spirit warrior caste, and the Chrysaor gradually earned the respect its capabilities deserved.

Both Blood Spirit and Snow Raven use the Chrysaor extensively in their ProtoMek forces. The Ravens have exported some units to their Inner Sphere operations, though one shipment of a full Star was raided by unknown pirates suspected of operating from Antallos. Diamond Shark merchants also acquired Chrysaors at bargain prices following erroneous reports of the design's poor showing on Arcadia, keeping a Point as a demonstration unit while selling others to Clans in the Inner Sphere. On Circe, Snow Raven Chrysaors of the Second Raven Garrison Cluster successfully repelled a Goliath Scorpion incursion, using their superior mobility to encircle Elemental formations and tear into them with massed laser fire until a late-arriving Griffin IIC turned the battle.

A close-combat variant, the Chrysaor 2, replaced the quad ER Micro Lasers with dual Micro Pulse Lasers and added five jump jets, trading sustained firepower for enhanced accuracy and terrain mobility. The variant was developed to address the Chrysaor's vulnerability in close terrain where its speed advantage could not be fully exploited.
